## Behavior and reproduction

Describe the expected and observed behavior, with a minimal reproduction.

## Component and environment

Include the component version/commit, OS/architecture, and ROS distribution if relevant. For a source build, include the vendored SDK UPSTREAM identity and any consumer adaptation. Include units, calibration revision and relevant health/drop counters when reporting acquisition or recording problems.

Use synthetic samples and redact private addresses, credentials and laboratory recordings. Report security vulnerabilities through the component's SECURITY.md process.

## Related components

Link related issues when a shared-core defect affects multiple consumers. Protocol/calibration/recovery fixes start in netft-cpp; each downstream repository owns its snapshot/adaptation and release acceptance.
